bonus.name: Frequent Asked Question
bonus.description:
{"Description":"","DescQuillEditor":{"ops":[{"insert":"

FAQ Which Currency We Accepted? AUD : Australia Dollar.

How To Create An Account?
Click the "REGISTER" button on the homepage to register. After successful registration, click the "DEPOSIT" button to deposit and click the "WITHDRAW" button to withdraw money.

Can I Register Multiple Accounts?
No. We strictly prohibit the registration of multiple accounts. Once the rules are violated, the account will be restricted and many benefits will be lost.

What Are The Deposit And Withdrawal Limits?
The minimum deposit is AUD10 The minimum withdrawal is AUD50 (Do not include the applied bonus) Deposit of any amount requires Rollover x1 (Total Bet) Withdrawals are limited to 5 times a day.

Can I Deposit If I Still Have Balance?
In order to avoid confusion in the bonus rules, you must play and bet your points after each deposit. Once the points are lower than AUD1 or after withdrawal, you will be able to submit the deposit again.

What Is Our ROLLOVER And TURNOVER?
Different companies have different abbreviations and rules, But in our company there are only rollover and turnover, all according to the following instructions. ROLLOVER : Total bet in game TURNOVER : Minimun withdraw / Final remain credit

Can I Claim Different Bonus At The Same Time?
No. You cannot apply multiple bonuses example Promotion, Bonus, Rebate, Commission at the same time. Although you can sometimes click on multiple different bonuses, this will superimpose the withdrawal rules on different bonuses. Once the rules are violated will forfeit the bonus.

Why Do Games Platforms Sometimes Disappear?
For a better game environment and effect, sometimes the game platforms will be maintenance. During the maintenance period, the game platform will be temporarily removed from the website, and once the repairs are completed, the game platform will be put on the website again.

I Have Met The Rollover Requirements, Why Can't I Withdraw Money? Deposit and applying for bonus will have rollover requirements. Once you complete the rollover requirements, Please exit the game completely and give the system some time to update the Rollover progress bar. Once the Rollover progress bar is full, withdrawals can be made.

Can I Change My Bank Account? In order to protect the bank accounts of both of us, we are strict customers to change the bank account, Unless your registered account is frozen/blocked, We will verify the authenticity and ask for some supporting documents.

What Should I Do If I Cannot Receive The Verification Code? To register a new user or reset a password if you forget your password, need to request a verification code, but sometimes can't receive the verification code. For security reasons, members cannot ask us directly in Live Chat. After contacting our customer service, We will provide two ways for us to verify the authenticity of the membership number.

Can Customer Service Create An Account For Me? No. For the authenticity of the user, The user must register and accept the mobile phone verification code, Please click the "REGISTER" button on the homepage to register.

General Terms & Conditions
If found illegal betting, abnormal betting situation, bonus hunting, side betting, save free game inside game & deposit to withdraw, TNT99 shall freeze the deposit (including the amount of the profit and bonus), the system will automatically clear the balance to zero (0).

"}]},"DescQuillHTML":"
